iut_type: End Product (Alps Alpine UXC10, automotive infotainment module for Volvo), RF/RF PHY test setup antenna and cable loss value
customer_question: We don't have a value for the antenna alone, so the figure we're providing includes cable loss as well -- is that acceptable? Also, is this cable loss value for the product's own antenna cable, or for the measurement cable? Our attached file currently lists the measurement cable's loss value. Also, we're still finalizing the BLE test mode, so please leave that as TBD for now.
question_variants: Can we provide a combined antenna-plus-cable-loss figure instead of an antenna-only value?
Should the path loss figure reflect the product's own antenna cable or the lab's measurement cable?
actual_issue: The customer needed to confirm whether a combined antenna-plus-cable-loss value (rather than an antenna-only value) was acceptable for RF test path loss compensation purposes, and needed clarification on which specific cable's loss value was being requested (the product's own antenna cable versus the lab's measurement cable), while also flagging that the BLE test mode configuration was still undecided.
plain_english_explanation: For RF test path loss compensation, a combined antenna-plus-connection-cable total value is acceptable when an antenna-only value isn't available -- the lab doesn't require the two figures to be separated. The specific cable loss value needed is the measurement cable's loss (i.e., the cable used to connect the DUT to the test system for measurement purposes), not the product's own internal antenna cable -- which is what the customer had already filled in by default, confirming their assumption was correct. The BLE test mode being left as TBD pending the customer's internal decision was acceptable, to be filled in once determined.
consultant_answer: Yes, a combined antenna-plus-connection-cable total value is fine -- we don't need the antenna-only figure separated out. And yes, the loss value needed is for the measurement cable, not the product's own antenna cable, so what you've already filled in is correct. Leaving the BLE test mode as TBD for now is fine -- just let us know once it's decided.
decision_logic: When a customer cannot provide an antenna-only loss value, accept a combined antenna-plus-cable total figure for RF test path loss compensation purposes, and clarify explicitly which specific cable (product's own antenna cable vs. the measurement/connection cable used for testing) the requested loss value refers to, since this ambiguity is a common point of confusion when a test sample documentation template doesn't specify.
final_recommendation: When requesting cable/antenna loss values from a customer for RF test setup, proactively specify whether an antenna-only or combined figure is acceptable, and explicitly clarify which physical cable (product's internal antenna cable vs. the lab's measurement/connection cable) the requested value refers to, to avoid customers guessing or providing the wrong figure.
risk_if_done_wrong: If the wrong cable's loss value were used in path loss compensation calculations, RF test measurement results could be inaccurately compensated, potentially producing incorrect Pass/Fail determinations.
